WC04 Camera 0.3.5 USB EXPERIMENTAL - PRIVATE LOCAL TEST ONLY

Copy apps/wc04-camera-experimental to the SD card's apps directory.
Replace the existing experimental folder's contents with this version; keep the
baseline apps/wc04-camera folder and earlier ZIPs. Confirm 0.3.5 in HBC; keep the working 0.3.2 ZIP.
0.3.5 changes only the menu refresh flow. Press 2: Refresh camera source.
The existing menu stays visible with an animated loading circle while a worker
reads descriptors. It does not start a preview or claim streaming was tested.
A supported result names the selected MJPEG size; A opens the viewfinder.
A missing/unsupported mode result suggests connecting a camera and pressing 2.
Changing size clears the previous result. Repeated presses and navigation are
consumed while refreshing. B requests cancellation; HOME requests exit. Both
wait for pending USB work to return and the worker to close its handle before
continuing. A stuck IOS call can still delay cancellation/exit; the app does not
force-kill USB work. No camera/firmware configuration changes are introduced.

The padding fix, shared 615424-byte cap, capture, recording, timers and USB
negotiation from physically tested 0.3.4 remain. The separate design mockups
have not been implemented: existing light Pearl styling and assets remain.

Short later test: keep the tested 0.3.4 ZIP. Confirm 0.3.5 in HBC. Press 2 at
both sizes and verify the loading circle and readable result stay on the menu.
Try repeated 2 and B while refreshing; verify no surprise viewfinder/recording.
Try HOME during refresh; it should exit once USB work returns. On another run,
refresh without a camera, reconnect and refresh again. A should still open the
viewfinder; save a still and short video at each supported size as a smoke test.
Return the appended session.log and describe any spinner or cancellation issue.

Requires Wii Remote, HBC under IOS58, writable FAT SD for saving.

Experimental subset: single-configuration UVC 1.0 cameras offering progressive
MJPEG at 320x240 or 640x480, isochronous IN with bInterval=1, advertised
frame buffer at most 615424 bytes and a supported descriptor default interval.
WC04 is preferred when connected. Otherwise the first supported interface wins.
Use one camera; change the menu size explicitly if that size is unsupported.
No actual speed is inferred from the USB version. Full-speed operation, hubs,
vWii and other configurations are unverified. No general compatibility guarantee.
Newer UVC 1.1/1.5 controls, bulk, YUYV, interlaced modes, proprietary protocols,
audio, multiple configurations and automatic reconnect are unsupported.
Refresh reads descriptors only; supported descriptors do not prove video.
The default frame interval is used; there is no guessed frame rate or fallback.
No configuration changes, device firmware, custom IOS or system modifications.
Insert SD before launch. The app never installs/reloads IOS or writes NAND.

Menu: A opens live view; 1 changes resolution; 2 refreshes camera source.
+ switches Photo / Video. Left/right selects timer Off / 3 / 5 / 10 seconds.
Photo: A captures or starts countdown; B cancels countdown, otherwise menu.
Review: A returns to live, B returns to menu.
Video: A starts, A or B stops and saves. Silent sampled MJPEG AVI only.
HOME exits, stopping camera and finalizing a video first.
No signal: A retries after timeout/failure; B returns to menu.

Photos: sd:/DCIM/100WC04/WC04####.JPG
Video: sd:/wc04-camera/videos/VID####.AVI
Log: sd:/wc04-camera/session.log (appended)
Existing files are never overwritten. Failed partial output from the current
attempt is removed best-effort; failed media may prevent cleanup. Power loss can leave a partial AVI. 9999 names per type.

Video stops at 60 seconds, 128 MiB, or 3600 accepted frames. There is no promised
frame rate or audio. SD/CPU load may skip frames. Saved duration follows elapsed
time, but sampled frames play evenly, so motion may be jerky. Computer playback
was host-tested with FFmpeg; Photo Channel video playback is not promised.

No decoded frame for 1 second shows full SMPTE bars; 10 seconds stops the stream.
Timer or pending shutter is canceled by lost signal. If USB drain waits, unplug the camera.
A wedged IOS or SD operation can still block; do not remove SD while saving.

This 0.3.5 UI update is host-tested and compiled, NOT physically verified.
Jaxi physically tested 0.3.4 on 0c45:6366 under IOS58: photos and silent video
at both sizes. Its log records 26.77 fps for the 320x240 test clip and 14.01 fps
for 640x480, with zero boundary/decoder rejects in 12 capture runs. These are
observed sampled rates, not promises. Camera model and console variant remain
unknown. Some early setup errors recovered on later attempts; their cause is
unproven. New media were not independently decoded in that log-only review.

Public redistribution rights are NOT established. This package is only for
Jaxi's private local test. The full OTF is not bundled. See licenses/UI-font.txt.
